body:
Disclaimer: I've done about 40 different drugs total and am experienced with Etizolam. Please do not start with my dosages as it would knock most people out.
Tolerance: Not had any sort of benzo in 7 days
Medical: I have EDS Type 2 and seem to have a naturally high tolerance to most benzos. I mainly use these for sleep but wanted to test Etizolam to it's full potential. I also suffer from social-anxiety so these pills are not used often by me recreationally.
+0 4mg dropped before my dinner, first of a new batch so started my dose out small
+30min Starting to feel relaxed, that 'numbs' Xanax gives me (particularly on my lips) is present
+45min Had a wee productive spell. Spent 20 minutes tidying and organising things around the house
+1hr Ate half a small pizza. Was good.
+2hr I feel enough time has passed for my second dose. I neck another 4mg
+3hr I feel a lot more motivated/creative. I find myself daydreaming about things I could do to improve my work
+3.5hr My pal shows up with weed and we do a few joints
+4hr I don't feel much different from my initial dose. I'm a little wobbly when walking but that's about it.
+5hr I'm able to open up to my girlfriend and we have a good talk about our relationship that I'd normally have difficulty expressing.
+6hr (11pm) - Sleepy time
Wake up at 7am feeling fresh (I normally sleep in and feel like shit in the morning) and feel a lot more positive.
Conclusion: While I love the recreational value of Xanax. These are also very nice and them being legal in my country (UK) is a massive bonus
